correctness.rationale: A fresh independent replay reconstructed the Fano incidence graph, enumerated all 458 independent sets with cardinality counts 1,14,70,154,147,56,14,2, and rebuilt the stated sequential matching. It leaves exactly six critical simplices, all of dimension three, and a complete orientation of all 1,582 Hasse covers is acyclic. In reduced discrete-Morse form this gives a basepoint and six three-cells with no lower positive-dimensional cells, hence a wedge of six three-spheres. The package's separate mod-two homology computation is consistent but is not used by itself to infer homotopy type.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic girth-six incidence graph, and its independence complex is a natural topological invariant already motivated by an exact independent-set extremal literature. The result determines homotopy, not just counts or homology, and contrasts with nearby regular-bipartite families whose homotopy types differ.
residual_risks: The theorem is graph-specific and supplies no projective-plane family formula.
